sources.title: GCC 16.1 released: C++26 reflection / contracts / safety hardening, C++20 by default, and more!

claims.claim: GCC 16.1 has been released! Lots of good C++26 material including reflection and contracts. GCC 16 Release Series: Changes, New Features, and Fixes From the announcement: C++20 by default: [...]  N.B. C++20 modules support is still experimental and must be enabled by  -fmodules . Several C++26 features have been implemented: P2996R13 , Reflection ( PR120775 , enabled by  -std=c++26 -freflection ) P3394R4 , Annotations for Reflection P3293R3 , Splicing a base class subobject P3096R

claims.claim: Glaze is a high-performance C++23 serialization library with compile-time reflection. It has grown to support many more formats and features, and in v7.2.0 C++26 Reflection support has been merged! Glaze 7.2 - C++26 Reflection | YAML, CBOR, MessagePack, TOML and more From the article: Glaze now supports C++26 reflection with experimental GCC and Clang compilers.
